name: 89081 · N Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89081 (N Las Vegas) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89081 (N Las Vegas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
54% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89081 (N Las Vegas) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 28% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 65% of all organizations here have no identified type.
